Heavy aggressive HANDHELD — witness-style, as if the operator is plastered against the inner face of the sealed door looking back down the corridor at the team approaching, vertical bounce of breath, lateral micro-drift, occasional hard jolt, focus hunting. Anamorphic ~28mm-equivalent for wide-angle witness perspective, lens at chest height (~1.4m), placed right at the door's threshold (the door is just behind camera, off-screen) — looking down the long corridor away from the door toward the oncoming charge. The door is NOT in frame — we are at it, looking back at what's coming.

Down the corridor in cool blue daylight: the leader stands planted in the foreground middle-distance (~5m from camera) at the head of the formation, half-turned over his right shoulder back toward the men behind him, his face in 3/4 toward camera-back, one black-gloved hand raised in a sharp signal at shoulder height. Behind him in the deeper corridor, the twelve red-hooded warrior monks have halted with the massive beam held at ready position — six on each side of the timber, knees softly bent, hands locked on the raw wood, the beam aimed straight down the corridor toward camera/the unseen door, the iron bands visible. The monks are coiled, breathing hard but held, waiting. The cool window god-rays cut through haze across the formation. Dust still drifts in the lower portion of frame from their charge.

The leader's chest rises with one big controlled breath. His raised hand chops down sharply through the air. He shouts the command in Tibetan, voice hard and clear, projecting down the corridor — the cadence is two distinct beats: a held preparatory call, then a sharp executing shout. On the second beat the team of twelve responds as one — they BURST forward, charging the beam straight at camera/the sealed door, the entire formation accelerating from standstill to ramming speed in two strides, the beam's tip leveling and aiming dead at the lens. Dust explodes off the flagstones around their sandals, the wood creaks and groans under the sudden acceleration, the iron bands chime, every cowl pitches forward with the effort. The camera shake becomes violent as the operator braces.

THE BEAM IMPACTS — the iron-banded tip slams into the door just behind camera with a deep thunderous WOODEN BOOM. The whole frame jolts hard from the concussion: dust EXPLODES outward from the impact point in a thick cloud blasting back into the corridor, the leader's body and the front rank of monks flinch with the kickback, splinters fly, the camera shakes violently then settles. The team holds the beam against the door for a beat, regrips. The leader's signal hand chops again. They reset, take three running steps back away from camera, then drive forward AGAIN — the second impact lands even harder, BOOM, more dust, the door visibly shuddering on its hinges (the heavy iron strap-hinges flexing audibly off-screen). They reset and drive a third time — BOOM — the wood of the door groaning, fine cracks beginning to spread audibly. The leader watches each impact with cold satisfaction, signal hand directing each strike. End on a held beat after the third hit — the team panting, beam still pressed against the door, dust hanging thick in the cool god-rays, the door not yet broken but visibly weakening. LOCATION: tight ancient stone corridor, two meters wide. Behind characters — fresh rubble collapse. Ahead — distant carved stone gateway with cold blue light. The massive stone slab continues its slow descent from the ceiling above the gateway — descended about halfway, opening still tall enough to walk through but shrinking gradually, never accelerating. Lit iron torches on both walls. Arrows embedded in walls from previous volley. Mid-corridor, an open pit where a tile collapsed — Jax hangs from its edge by his fingertips, dark pit with stone spikes in darkness below.

CHARACTERS:
— Rain (<<<image_2>>>): silver-blonde hair disheveled, scar by eye, fresh cut on temple, grey hooded jacket, dusty. Mid-run between Roco and Jax.
— Jax (<<<image_3>>>): yellow buzzcut, dark skin, clear glasses, dark jacket, dusty. Hanging from edge of pit by his fingertips, body dangling into darkness, arms straining.
— Roco (<<<image_4>>>): dark messy hair, mustache, red bandage on nose, dark jacket, dusty. Running toward gateway, halfway there when click happens.

Shot 1 (0–3s): Handheld HIGH-ANGLE close-up shot looking DOWN at Jax from above the pit edge — camera positioned above him, looking down into the pit, the dark stone walls of the pit framing his face from above. His face fills the lower half of the frame, terrified, dust-streaked. His arms strain visible at the top of frame, fingers gripping the stone lip. The dark pit drops away below him into shadow. He looks UP toward camera (toward where Roco runs), eyes wide with raw fear. He SCREAMS, voice cracking with full terror: "ROCO!!" Camera trembles intensely with the operator's reaction to his scream.

Shot 2 (3–6s): Hard cut to handheld long-lens medium shot of Roco mid-run from a three-quarter angle, sprinting toward the gateway. Camera tracks with his motion, intense shake. Hard torch light slashes across his features. He hears Jax's scream — his stride HESITATES, head WHIPS back over his shoulder. His face shows the conflict — duty pulling forward, brotherhood pulling back. The slowly descending slab visible in deep background, opening gradually shrinking but still tall.

Shot 3 (6–9s): Handheld long-lens close-up of Rain mid-run, three-quarter angle. Camera trembling intensely with her motion. She glances back over her shoulder — her eyes register Jax's situation in soft bokeh deep behind her — then her head SNAPS forward toward Roco running ahead of her. She SHOUTS forward at Roco's back, voice straining with urgency: "The door!" She stabs her finger forward toward the slowly closing gateway, commanding him to keep going.

Shot 4 (9–12s): Hard cut to handheld long-lens medium close-up of Roco from three-quarter angle, mid-stride. He has STOPPED running, body skidding to a halt with dust kicking up, body turning back to face Rain. His eyes lock onto hers behind him. He SHAKES his head once, sharply — refusal. He shouts back at her, voice raw and absolute: "GO!" His command leaves no room. Camera shakes intensely with the emotional weight.

Shot 5 (12–15s): Handheld long-lens medium tracking shot from low angle, the camera catching Roco as he plants his foot and TURNS, body launching back into a sprint, running BACK toward the pit, away from the gateway. Camera trembles, tracking with his reverse motion. Halated torch light streaks past as he runs back into the depth of the corridor, dust kicking up behind him. In deep background bokeh, the closing gateway recedes — Rain's silhouette continues running forward toward it. They move in opposite directions in the same frame.

8K IMAX, photorealistic, photographed on a physical motion-picture camera (no 3D render, no game engine). Modern action blockbuster — cinematography in the lineage of Lubezki and Deakins. Shot on anamorphic cine optics — natural anamorphic depth-of-field falloff and oval bokeh, slight horizontal compression of background highlights, BUT NO ANAMORPHIC LENS FLARES, no horizontal streak flares, no blue-line artifacts. Lighting: only natural light and practicals, contre-jour with atmospheric haze. Color: 60:30:10 — dominant deep crimson-red of the warrior monks' robes, secondary cool slate-blue daylight, accent warm amber from a single floor oil-lamp. 180° shutter motion blur, photorealistic skin (pores, sweat-shine, capillary flush, micro-saccades), corner vignette and edge chromatic aberration. Gravity, mass and contact shadows respected — the heavy beam reads as real weight, every footfall lands grounded, dust kicked up by the rush. Hollywood-grade acting — micro-pauses, no playing to camera. 60fps, 2.39:1, no jitter, no identity drift. Environmental SFX only — no music, no subtitles, no on-screen text.

LOCATION (held across all shots): a long ancient monastic corridor, DAY. Walls of dark-stained carved hardwood with painted thangka scrolls hanging on the walls and tall narrow windows with diamond lattice grilles down one side, casting hard cool blue-white daylight shafts through heavy atmospheric haze and dust — visible god-rays cutting across the corridor. Ceiling: dark coffered hardwood beams. Floor: large worn dark grey flagstone slabs polished by centuries of bare feet, faintly reflective. A single small bronze floor oil-lamp on a tall ornate stand burns near one wall, throwing a warm amber pool. AT THE FAR END of the corridor: a massive carved dark-hardwood double-door, deeply carved with concentric panels and iron strap-hinges, sealed shut — the target.

CHARACTERS:
— LEADER: lean Asian man, mid-40s, fully shaven head, deep-set serious eyes, a clean vertical surgical-looking scar running down the right side of his forehead through the brow onto the cheekbone, weathered skin; wearing a sleeveless black raw-cotton wrap-tunic crossed at the chest and tied at the waist with a wide flat black sash, loose black trousers gathered into black cloth ankle wraps, black split-toe tabi socks/sandals, black cloth forearm wraps from elbow to wrist on both arms, black fingerless cloth gloves. Lean conditioned build. Walks with absolute purpose, no rush, no doubt.
— RED MONKS (8 of them carrying the beam): each a young to mid-30s East Asian combat monk, athletic conditioned build, faces concealed by deep crimson cloth hoods pulled fully forward (only a strip of jaw visible at the bottom edge of the cowl, eyes lost in pure shadow inside the cowl), red cloth half-mask covering nose and mouth under the cowl. Wardrobe: deep crimson sleeveless raw-cotton wrap-vest tied at the chest, bare conditioned forearms wrapped tightly in dark crimson cloth bandages from wrist to mid-forearm, loose deep crimson trousers gathered into matching crimson ankle wraps, simple flat sandals on bare feet, a wide muted-saffron sash knotted at the waist. Fabric matte raw cotton, sweat-darkened at the chest and back, fine dust along the lower hems. Identical from man to man — anonymous, repeatable, a uniform.
— THE BEAM: a massive cylindrical tree-trunk battering ram, ~6 meters long, ~50cm diameter, raw weathered hardwood with the bark stripped, deep tool-marks and adze-cuts along the surface, fine cracks in the end-grain, two heavy black wrought-iron bands clamped tightly around the log near each end. Real heavy mass — the wood reads as solid, dense, deeply grained.

SHOT 1 — LEADER ADVANCES, HALF-PROFILE TRACKING. Heavy aggressive HANDHELD throughout — witness-style instability, vertical bounce of the operator running ahead and to the side of the leader, lateral whip-corrections, occasional reframe jolt. Anamorphic ~50mm-equivalent, moderate oval-bokeh DoF, lens at chest height (~1.4m), 1.8m from the leader, framed in clean half-profile (3/4 angle from his side) so we read the line of his face from the cheekbone to the ear and the forward thrust of his body. The corridor recedes behind him in soft focus, cool blue-white daylight from the windows on one side rim-lighting the side of his face, the warm amber floor-lamp glow blooming as a soft amber bokeh ball deeper down the corridor behind him. Diamond-lattice god-rays cut across the upper portion of frame in haze.

The leader strides directly forward at a steady purposeful pace, shaven crown catching the cool window light, the surgical-looking vertical scar along the side of his forehead and cheekbone clean and pale, jaw set hard, dark eyes locked dead ahead — never breaking forward focus, never glancing aside. He does not speak. His arms swing minimally, body controlled, every footfall on flagstone deliberate — the man who has decided. Behind him in slightly softer focus, a wall of crimson-hooded warrior monks in close formation sprinting hard, arms pumping, faces lost inside their deep red cowls, sandals slapping flagstone, dust kicked up around their ankles in a thick rolling cloud catching the cool window light. The leader does not look back. The handheld shake is constant, the camera struggling to keep up with his forward drive. Audio: leader's even controlled breath close on mic, the heavy thunder of sandals slapping flagstone in the deeper plane behind him, fabric rustle of robes in motion, dust hiss, faint daylight ambience, deep corridor reverb tail.

SHOT 2 — RED MONKS CARRY THE BEAM, PROFILE CLOSE-UP ON ONE MONK. Strict clean side-on profile to the line of travel, heavy verité handheld — operator running parallel with the team, vertical bounce, lateral whip-corrections, focus hunts that miss and snap back. Anamorphic ~75mm-equivalent, shallow oval-bokeh DoF, lens at hip height (~1m), close to the line of the beam (~1.5m off-axis from it). Cool blue-white daylight floods the corridor from the windows on one side, hard god-rays through haze cutting across the moving formation.

In the FOREGROUND in razor-sharp profile, focus locked on ONE specific monk — middle of the line on the near side of the beam, his crimson cowl pulled fully forward, only the bottom strip of jaw and throat visible below the hood, sweat-shined skin, the half-mask of red cloth covering his nose and mouth visible at the edge of the cowl shadow. His bandaged forearms cord with tendon and vein where his hands grip the raw timber, knuckles white through the crimson wrap-bandages. The wide saffron sash flaps at his waist with the rhythm of his stride. His conditioned shoulder hunches into the load, chest visibly heaving under the wrap-vest. Each footfall lands grounded, sandal slapping flagstone hard, knee flexing deep on impact.

In the FOREGROUND-EDGE and BACKGROUND in soft focus: portions of the massive beam itself filling the upper third of the frame as a long horizontal mass of raw hardwood with deep tool-marks visible on its surface, the heavy wrought-iron band clamped near the visible end. Behind and ahead of the focus monk, his fellow team members carrying the beam — soft blurred crimson silhouettes on both sides of the timber, all moving in synchronized stride, hooded heads bobbing with the rhythm. Together, eight bodies moving as one engine carrying the wood. Dust hisses up around their ankles in a low rolling cloud catching the cool window light in plumes. The corridor's coffered hardwood ceiling and tall lattice windows pass behind them in compressed motion-blur as the camera tracks.

The handheld shake matches the rhythm of the running. The whole formation reads as a single eight-legged engine carrying a tool, anchored by the one sharp face we can almost-but-not-quite see. Audio: heavy synchronized footfalls of eight men slapping flagstone, the deep wooden creak of the timber under load, iron bands faintly chiming as the beam shifts, breath from eight lungs, fabric rustle, dust hiss, deep corridor reverb.

SHOT 3 — TEAM ARRIVES AT THE DOOR, READIES THE BEAM, MEDIUM. Heavy verité handheld — operator backed up against the wall to the side of the door, lens at chest height (~1.4m), framing a medium shot that sees the team approach the door head-on with the door itself in the upper-right portion of frame. Anamorphic ~35mm-equivalent for wide read of the action, moderate oval-bokeh DoF. Cool blue-white daylight from windows on one side, dust thick in the air from the team's charge, god-rays cutting through.

The team of EIGHT crimson-hooded monks reaches the front of the corridor with the massive beam still gripped between them — four on each long side, hands locked on the raw timber, beam riding at hip-to-shoulder height. They slow from their running jog into a controlled approach, sandals dragging slightly on flagstone as they brake. Saffron sashes settle. Their cowled heads turn as one toward the massive carved sealed door now directly ahead of them. They wheel the front of the beam around, muscles cording with the effort of controlling the long log's momentum, until the iron-banded leading tip of the beam is pointed dead at the center of the carved door, level at chest height, ~3 meters out from the door's surface. Knees flex. Hands regrip on the timber. The whole eight-man formation settles into a coiled ready stance, the beam held steady, every cowl pitched forward in concentration. Sweat drips from chins below the hoods. Heavy controlled breathing in unison. The leader is just out of frame to one side, watching. Hold a beat — beam aimed, men coiled, dust still settling around their ankles from the approach. Audio: footfalls slowing into a stop with cathedral reverb, heavy wooden creak as the beam wheels around, iron bands chiming as the timber shifts, eight lungs breathing hard in unison, fabric settle, dust hiss, deep corridor sub-bass.

SHOT 4 — LEADER GIVES THE COMMAND, LOW-ANGLE CLOSE-UP. Tight chest-up close-up on the leader, low-angle. Anamorphic ~75mm-equivalent, shallow oval-bokeh DoF. Camera planted low on the flagstones (~0.5m height) pushing up at a steep low angle into a 3/4 frontal framing of his face from his front-side — he reads tall and monumental against the carved coffered hardwood ceiling and god-ray haze far above; the cool window light catches the side of his face and the surgical-looking scar, while the warm amber floor-lamp behind him blooms as a soft bokeh ball over his shoulder. Lens 1.2m from him, faint handheld breath.

The leader fills the lower portion of frame from below, jaw set hard, dark eyes locked dead ahead at the unseen sealed door past camera. A long even breath. He raises his right black-gloved hand sharply into frame at shoulder height in a held signal, fingers extended together, palm vertical — the universal cue. A small pre-speech swallow, throat moving. He shouts the command in Tibetan, voice hard and clear, projecting forward over the team — the cadence in two distinct beats: the held preparatory call, a half-beat pause, then the sharp executing shout. On the second beat his raised hand chops down sharply through the air in a clean decisive arc. His eyes never leave the door. Hold a beat as his hand finishes the chop — face still locked forward, command issued. Audio: leader's two-beat Tibetan command delivered hard and clear close-mic with corridor reverb, sharp inhale from eight men in unison off-screen at the chop, deep corridor sub-bass build, dust hiss.

SHOT 5 — THE RAM STRIKES, MEDIUM. Heavy aggressive HANDHELD — witness-style, lens at chest height (~1.4m), framing a medium shot 3/4 angle on the line of action — we see the eight-man team in profile to one side of frame as they drive the beam forward, and the carved sealed door filling the other side as the target, the angle arranged so we read both the bodies driving the timber and the impact face of the door together. Anamorphic ~35mm-equivalent for wide immersive read, moderate oval-bokeh DoF. Cool god-rays cut across the upper portion of frame, dust thick in the air, the warm amber floor-lamp throwing flicker on the wall behind them.

At the leader's command the team of eight EXPLODES forward in one synchronized drive, the formation accelerating from coiled standstill to ramming speed in two strides, sandals slamming flagstone hard, eight bodies leaning into the timber as one. The iron-banded leading tip of the beam levels and aims dead at the center of the carved door. They hit. The beam SLAMS into the door — a deep thunderous WOODEN BOOM, dust EXPLODES outward from the impact point in a thick cloud, the door visibly shudders in its frame and the heavy iron strap-hinges flex audibly under the load, but the door HOLDS — it does not break, does not split, does not crack. The whole frame jolts hard from the concussion, the camera shakes violently then steadies. The team's bodies absorb the kickback, cowls pitching forward then settling, hands regripping the timber. The leader's voice off-screen barks the command again. They take three controlled running steps back away from the door, reset their footing, then drive forward AGAIN — the second impact lands even harder, BOOM, more dust, the door shudders harder this time, the carved panels visibly stressing, but again it holds. They reset and drive a third time — BOOM — the heavy iron hinges flex audibly under the load, fine splinters fly off the door's surface, the wood of the door groans deeply, but the seal still holds. End on a held beat after the third hit — the team panting, beam still pressed against the door, eight chests heaving in their crimson vests, dust hanging thick in the cool god-rays, the door dented and stressed but not yet broken. The mission is going to take more than three hits. Audio: sharp synchronized inhale from eight men as they launch, the beam's wood groan under acceleration, eight pairs of sandals slamming flagstone in a thunder, iron bands chime, then the massive WOODEN BOOM of impact with deep sub-bass and long corridor reverb tail, dust roar, splintering crackle, door hinges flexing with metallic stress; the cycle repeats — reset shuffle, leader's bark, charge thunder, BOOM — three times, each impact with more wood-stress crackle than the last; final beat held with eight men panting, faint tick of stressed wood, deep corridor sub-bass dying, dust hiss.

Setting: tight stone corridor with carved walls and torches receding into warm bokeh on both sides, wet stone floor, atmospheric dust haze, slab grinding rumble in the distance.

Shot 1 (5s) — TWO-CHARACTER HANDHELD close up SHOT:
The man stands in the corridor facing camera, breathing hard, sweat and dust on his face. The woman runs into frame from behind him and slams to a halt beside him, breath ragged. She shouts at him, urgent and desperate: "Jax!" He grabs her by the arm, locks eyes with her, and shouts back, raw and final: "Run!" He releases her, turns sharply, and runs past camera back into the corridor depth, disappearing behind the lens. Camera tight handheld, breathing with the action, frame trembling. Telephoto lens, shallow depth of field, corridor dissolves into warm torch bokeh.

Shot 2 (4s) —  CLOSE-UP ON RAIN'S FACE:
Hard cut. Camera pushes in close on the woman's face. She stands frozen, watching the man recede off-frame behind camera. Her eyes track him, breath ragged, dust and the cut on her temple visible. The weight of his choice settles on her face — eyes glistening with held tears, jaw clenching, brow furrowing in pained acknowledgment. She closes her eyes briefly, takes one deep breath. Her face hardens with resolve. Then she turns sharply on her heel and sprints away from camera in the opposite direction toward the distant gateway, her hair flying as she recedes into the corridor depth dissolved in warm torch bokeh. Camera tight handheld, intimate proximity to her face throughout, then holds steady as she runs into the deep distance.

Photorealistic, 35mm film grain, motion blur, warm torch light with deep shadows, intimate handheld feel throughout both shots.

Sounds: distant slab grinding throughout both shots, torches crackling. Shot 1 — ragged breathing, woman's straining "Jax!", running footsteps slamming to halt, man's raw "Run!", his boots accelerating away past camera. The FIRST iron torch nearest camera IGNITES with a soft whump, flame blooming into a halated orange flare, bokeh balls scattering across the frame from dust particles. The NEXT torch ignites deeper down — appearing first as a defocused glowing sphere, then snapping into resolution as focus racks to it. Shot 2 (4–8s): Hard cut to a long-lens tight close-up of Rain's face from a low three-quarter angle, shot at f/1.2 — only her eyes are in razor-sharp focus, her cheekbones and the cut on her temple falling off into soft focus. Cold blue light from her handheld tablet (held just below frame, glowing up onto her face) mixes with warm orange torch light from behind, creating dual-tone contrast across her features. The corridor behind her dissolves into a wash of orange torch bokeh orbs and floating dust. Her eyes flick down to the tablet screen, then back up to the corridor ahead. She says with quiet authority: "Final stretch. Forty feet." Her breath fogs faintly in the cold air, drifting through the bokeh.

Shot 3 (8–11s): Hard cut to a tight extreme close-up of Jax's hand approaching the carved glyphs on a side pillar, shot on long lens at f/1.2. Only his fingertips at the moment of contact are in sharp focus, the rest of his hand and the wall surface dissolving into soft creamy bokeh. The nearest torch flickers warm halated light across the carvings, individual dust motes glowing as bokeh balls in the beam. His fingers slide across the surface, dust shifting beneath them. Pull focus from the stone surface to his eye behind glasses — wide, fascinated, distracted. Off-frame his voice, slightly rough from inhaled dust, almost wonderstruck: "Yo. These markings. Look at 'em."

Shot 4 (11–15s): Hard cut to long-lens medium close-up of Rain in profile, shot at f/1.2 — her face in sharp focus, the corridor ahead and behind dissolved into orange bokeh. She lowers the tablet slightly, eyes narrowing. The blue tablet glow fades from her face, leaving only the warm torch light from one side. She turns her head slightly, scanning the corridor. Her instinct kicks in. She says, lower and more urgent than before, with a tightness in her voice: "Guys. Something's off." A beat. Eyes flick to where Jax is off-frame at the wall. "Stay close." The line lands quiet but heavy. Hold on her face. Cut.

Setting: a narrow ancient stone corridor with low ceiling, two meters wide. Iron torches on both close walls. Carved hieroglyph walls. Wet stone floor. Thick atmospheric dust haze. In the middle of the corridor: an open trap pit with the dark-skinned yellow-haired man hanging by his fingertips, slipping, panicking. At the far end of the corridor in deep shadow: a massive stone slab grinding down loudly from above, closing the dark gateway, dust cascading from its edges in heavy waves. The slab's grinding rumble is loud, immediate, threatening — the men have seconds.

Action: The dark-haired man comes in fast, body skidding hard at the pit edge, almost falling in himself. He drops to his knee with violent force, throws his hand down into the pit without looking, no time to aim. The yellow-haired man's hand snaps up and catches it on the first try — both gripping desperately. The dark-haired man instantly hauls back with a sharp grunt, ripping his friend up out of the pit in one violent jerk. The yellow-haired man's body comes up over the edge fast, almost flung, landing hard on his hands and knees on the wet stone. The dark-haired man is already up — he grabs his friend's jacket and yanks him upright, no pause. They sprint together immediately, no recovery time, the dark-haired man's hand gripping his friend's back propelling him forward. Both men sprint away from camera into the corridor depth, fleeing the loudly grinding gateway behind them.

Camera: handheld throughout but UNSTABLE — the operator is running in the action, frame jerking violently, occasionally losing the subjects briefly before snapping back, camera tilts hard with each running impact. Pushes in extreme tight on the meeting of hands at the contact point when they catch each other — frame fully filled by gripping fingers, shaking with the desperate energy. Camera barely keeps up as bodies move fast through frame. Telephoto lens, shallow depth of field, the corridor blurring past in chaotic warm bokeh streaks from the running motion.

Photorealistic, 35mm film grain, motion blur smeared on every action, warm orange torch light against deep crushed blacks, dust cascading visibly from the gateway slab in the deep distance.

Sounds: LOUD continuous slab grinding rumble dominating the audio, urgent and threatening — the slab is closing fast. Both men's fast hyperventilating breath, short panicked gasps not full inhales. Running boots SLAMMING wet stone hard at full sprint. Skidding halt with explosive dust impact at the pit edge. Knee SLAMMING stone with bone impact thud. Friend's panicked shout from the pit cut off mid-breath. Hands SLAPPING with violent grip impact, loud and physical. Dark-haired man's hard grunt of effort RIPPING through gritted teeth as he hauls. Friend's body THUDDING up over the edge with cloth scrape on stone. Dark-haired man's sharp shouted grunt: "GO!" Both men's boots slamming back into a sprint, hurried unsynced rhythm, loud, urgent, footsteps pounding away into the distance. No music.

Zero added cinematic fills — no softboxes, no LED strips, no front fill, no reflectors outside the frame. Camera always shoots from the shadow side — face lit naturally by practicals, contours rimmed, wet catch-lights in the eyes. Color: 60:30:10. Physical cine lens. 180° shutter motion blur. Skin: pore-level realism — vellus hair, asymmetric moles, capillary flush, pore-shadow matching on-set light. Acting: Hollywood — micro-pauses before reactions, precise eye-line, wet living eyes with catch-lights, visible breath and chest rise, every emotion has muscular specificity. Physics: gravity and inertia fully respected — mass has real weight, correct contact shadows. No floating props. Composition: rule of thirds + golden ratio. Every person moving from frame one. Continuity: characters, props, environment identical across every cut. No identity drift. 24fps. 8K detail. Environmental SFX only. No music. No subtitles.

[SHOT 1 — HIGH ANGLE WIDE, STATIC]
Static camera, high angle from above looking down at <<<image_2>>> alone in the training dome. Camera does not move. Roko stands near center of the arena, a small pool of blood gathered around his boots — drips that came from his nose. He holds his hands raised in front of him at chest level, palms up, looking at them — a posture of attempted control. His body is still. Visible breathing — tired, slow, not panicked. The breath of a man who has tried this many times before.

[SHOT 2 — TOP SHOT 90° OVER BLOOD POOL]
Hard cut to top shot, camera 90° straight down over the small pool of blood at Roko's feet. The blood is glossy on the dark composite floor. In the reflection of the pool we see Roko from above — his upper body, arms raised in front of him, hands held out palms up. The reflection is broken slightly by the surface tension of the blood, fresh drops occasionally extending the ripples.

[SHOT 3 — MEDIUM, LOW ANGLE, HANDHELD]
Hard cut to medium shot, camera low, angled up at Roko. Slight handheld micro-shake — alive, not aggressive. Roko stands alone facing the center of the training arena. Dried blood under his nose. He looks at each hand in turn, jaw tight. He braces himself, muscles in his forearms tensing.

From the knuckles of BOTH hands simultaneously a crystalline structure begins to emerge — barely a centimeter — and immediately cracks and crumbles on both hands at once with a dry mineral sound. Fresh blood begins to flow from his nose again. A tired, frustrated exhale through his nose. Disappointment crosses his face. After the exhale he closes his eyes for about half a second — the closure of a man forcing himself not to give up. He wipes the blood from under his nose with the back of his hand. He lowers his arms.

He looks forward. Expression shifts from anger to resolve — the corrugator muscle between the brows releases, not a smile or calm, but the specific muscular moment of a decision made: not the appearance of an expression, but the disappearance of one.

Before speaking: one slow inhale through the nose. His gaze rises from his hands and fixes forward into empty space. Then — the line. Spoken to himself, calibrating himself toward confidence:

ROKO: "Fuck it... 'Open.'"

[SHOT 4 — WIDE FROM BEHIND ROKO]
Wide shot from behind Roko. His back occupies the left edge of frame; the rest of the composition is the center of the training arena. Roko does not move — stands and watches, a pause. After his line: in the center of the platform a square panel in the floor opens, and a Training Bot rises slowly on a lift mechanism to its full standing height.

[SHOT 5 — WIDE PROFILE, BOTH CHARACTERS]
Wide profile shot, both characters in frame side-on. They stand only a few steps apart — no more than two to three meters. Both frozen in the moment of first assessment. The bot is not assessing a threat — it stands in combat readiness, awaiting a command (the bot is a training device, not an opponent). Roko evaluates his target.

15 seconds. 16:9. SFX only: dry crystal fragment crack · boot on platform · blood drop on floor · hydraulic floor panel · bot rise mechanism.

- These scratches are FRESH — happened recently, hours ago, not days
- Bright red along the cut line, with thin trails of dried-darker blood beginning to crust at the edges
- Some are still slightly weeping at points — small dark wet spots along the cut
- Thin, linear, irregular — like cuts from sharp impact (a punch with a sharp edge, debris, a glancing blade)
- NOT deep gashes, NOT dramatic — realistic small cuts that would happen in close combat
- Skin around each scratch is slightly inflamed/reddened — recent injury
- AVOID: symmetric patterns, parallel claw marks, theatrical bleeding, gaping wounds

2. DRIED BLOOD FROM ONE NOSTRIL:
Add a trail of dried blood coming from the LEFT nostril (only one side, not both).

CHARACTER:
- Color: dark red-brown, dried, matte — not fresh wet bright red
- The blood started at the left nostril and ran down — natural gravity flow
- Trail runs from the nostril down across the upper lip, possibly onto the mustache, ending somewhere on the chin or jaw
- Width: irregular, thicker near the nostril (where it pooled briefly), thinner as it dried mid-flow
- Some of the blood has flaked or smudged where he wiped at it with the back of his hand or sleeve — partial smear, not a clean line
- The mustache may have darker patches where blood soaked into the hair
- Source narrative: he took a hit to the face, or the strain of internal force broke a vessel — both readings work
- Around the nostril itself: small crusted droplet, slightly darker
- AVOID: symmetric bleeding from both nostrils, fresh wet flowing blood, theatrical horror movie nosebleed

3. BLOOD ON TEETH (subtle):
Add small amounts of blood on his teeth, visible when his mouth is slightly parted or when his lips part slightly during the close-up.

CHARACTER:
- Mouth doesn't need to be wide open — just enough to see hint of teeth between parted lips
- Blood is concentrated between the teeth and along the gum line — dark red filling the gaps between teeth
- A slight smear of blood on the lower lip from the inside, visible at the edge
- Possible small split in the lower lip itself — a tiny vertical crack with blood at it (suggesting he bit his lip during exertion or got hit in the mouth)
- Color: deeper red than the dried nose blood — fresher, slightly wet
- Subtle, not gory — a viewer notices it on close inspection
- The teeth themselves remain natural color, just with blood between and around them
- AVOID: fully bloody mouth, blood pouring from lips, vampire-style staining

OVERALL TONE:
These three details together tell the story: he was just in a fight. He took hits to the face. His nose bled and dried. His mouth bled from being struck or from biting down through pain. Small scratches mark close combat. He survived but he was hit. The damage on his face must MATCH the damage already visible on his body and clothes — same fight, same intensity.

PRESERVE EVERYTHING ELSE:
- Same nose scar (do not modify)
- Same exhausted under-eye darkness
- Same wet hair, same dirt patterns
- Same outfit, same gear, same plush keychain
- Same gray studio backdrop
- Same lighting setup
- Same body scratches on arms (those stay as healing older scratches — the new ones are only on the face)
- Same overall expression — burned out, hollow, distant

Only the three specified additions to the face. Nothing else changes.

Setting: vast cavern-sanctum carved from natural rock, towering carved stone column-faces receding into darkness on both side walls, irregular flagstone floor, two parallel lines of small oil-lamps flickering warm amber along the walls, ceiling lost in shadow far above, dust-hazed atmosphere. Roco lies face-down on the flagstones a couple of meters from the side wall, dust-covered. Jax kneels beside him, jacket scuffed. Rain crouches a meter behind Jax, hoverboard set down on the flagstone beside her, one hand braced on the floor, leaning forward toward Roco — she has just dropped to crouch, watching, tense.

Shot 1 (0-2s): Handheld extreme low-angle close on Roco's face pressed against the flagstone, 100mm long lens, razor-thin focus on his eye. Camera lies on the floor inches from his face. Dust-streaked cheek against cold stone. His eyelid flutters, then opens — pupil dilating in the dark. A faint twitch in his brow as awareness returns. He exhales softly. Off-screen above, Jax's voice low and close: "Roco. Hey." Roco's eye tracks up toward the voice. Frame breathes with intimate handheld drift. Audio: deep ambient cavern drone, distant water drop with chamber reverb, Roco's slow ragged inhale magnified by closeness, faint oil-lamp crackle.

Shot 2 (2-3.5s): Cut to handheld close on Jax leaning down toward Roco from above, 85mm, three-quarter angle. Jax's face dust-streaked, brow tight, eyes scanning Roco's off-frame face. He sees the response, exhales a small relieved breath. His expression shifts to focused — about to act. He reaches down toward Roco's forearm. In shallow-focus blur behind Jax's shoulder, Rain's silhouette is visible crouched close, leaning in, watching. Audio: his line tail with chamber reverb, his exhale of relief, Rain's quiet exhale of relief mixing with his, ambient drone underneath.

Shot 3 (3.5-6.5s): Cut to handheld low-rising shot beside the two men, 50mm wider lens. Jax grips Roco's forearm — fingers locking around the wrist. He shifts his weight back, plants his foot, and HAULS Roco upward. Roco grunts, pushes off the floor with his free hand, comes up onto his knees, then to his feet in one continuous motion, dust falling from his jacket. He staggers on landing, catches Jax's shoulder briefly with his free hand for balance. Jax's other hand comes up to steady Roco's elbow. Rain rises with them in the same continuous motion, picking up the hoverboard from the floor as she stands, stepping into the frame from behind Jax — her hand goes to Roco's other arm, briefly, just above the elbow, a steadying touch as he finds his feet. The three of them in a tight knot for a beat — Roco between Jax and Rain, both supporting him without making it heavy. Roco gives Jax a small nod, then Rain a small nod. The camera RISES WITH THEM continuously, operator standing. Frame drifts and corrects, alive. Audio: scrape of grip, Jax's grunt of effort, Rain's small exhale as she rises and steps in, scrape of Roco's boots finding flagstone, Roco's heavy exhale, all three breathing heavily, ambient drone, chamber reverb deepening.

Shot 4 (6.5-8s): Cut to handheld medium close on Rain, 100mm, three-quarter profile. Her hand is still resting just above Roco's elbow in the foreground (Roco's arm visible blurred at the edge of frame). She holds the hoverboard at her side in her other hand, purple thruster glow soft accent. Her face is dust-streaked, brow soft with worry now that the action is over — the relief showing more openly. The cold light catches the scar by her eye. Her eyes are on Roco's face off-frame, searching it. She speaks, voice low and warm, the worry audible underneath, with chamber reverb: "You good?" A beat. Her hand gives his arm a small squeeze before she lets go. Camera breathes around her, drifts subtly closer. Audio: her controlled breathing with a faint waver of held-back worry, the question soft and close with long reverb tail, the small fabric-creak of her hand squeezing his arm, ambient drone, distant oil-lamp crackle.

Shot 5 (8-9.5s): Cut to handheld extreme close-up on Roco's face, 100mm, dust-streaked, the red bandage on his nose visible. He's let go of Jax's shoulder, Rain's hand has just left his arm. He turns his head briefly to meet Rain's eyes off-frame — gives her a small reassuring half-smile, the kind that says I'm here, don't worry — then his eyes go forward, past her, fixing on something distant in the sanctum off-screen. His jaw sets. His answer comes flat but warm at the edges, with chamber reverb: "Let's move." Frame breathes intimately on his face. Audio: his line with strong reverb tail, his breath settling, ambient drone.

Shot 6 (9.5-12s): Cut to handheld medium tight three-shot on the trio from a low front angle, 50mm. Roco center, eyes forward. Jax right of frame, gives Roco's shoulder a brief firm tap — good, we go — and steps back to clear his path. Rain left of frame, hoverboard at her side, eyes lingering on Roco's profile for half a second longer than Jax's before she shifts her weight forward. Roco takes the first step into the chamber. Jax falls in on his right. Rain a beat behind, the hoverboard swinging slightly with her stride. Camera dollies backward at their pace, framing them tight from waist-up walking toward camera. Behind them in deep shallow-focus blur: the dark interior of the sanctum receding, oil-lamp lines stretching away. Frame drifts with operator's breath, walking with them. Audio: Jax's tap on Roco's shoulder, Roco's first boot striking flagstone, Jax falling in step, Rain joining a beat later — three pairs of boots in slightly staggered rhythm with chamber reverb, breathing settling into walking pattern, ambient drone underneath.

CAMERA: long lens 50mm-100mm. Shots 1, 4, 5 are 100mm intimate close-ups. Shot 2 is 85mm close. Shots 3 and 6 are 50mm wider. Handheld throughout, alive, breath-driven, the operator a fourth presence. Clean direct cuts. Frame constantly drifts, reactive but never jittery. Shallow depth of field f/1.8-f/2. Cold blue-grey palette, warm oil-lamp accents, soft purple glow accents from the hoverboard's thruster cores.

ACTING:
- Roco: returns slowly, accepts the help with brief braces and small nods. His "Let's move" is decision but he gives Rain a half-smile before turning forward — the smile is the warmth, the line is the resolve.
- Jax: caregiver and operator. "Roco. Hey." direct and intimate, using the name to bring him back. His haul is muscular, efficient. The shoulder tap at the end is the verbal "we're good" without words.
- Rain: she crouches close as he wakes (not standing back), she rises with the men and steps in to steady his other arm, she squeezes his arm before letting go, her "You good?" is soft with audible worry underneath, her eyes linger on him longer than Jax's before they move. The hoverboard set down beside her at the start tells us she dropped it to be near Roco — she chose him over carrying it. She is the team's leader and a person who is scared for him; both can be true at once.

AUDIO: deep ambient cavern drone, distant water drops with chamber reverb, oil-lamp crackles, breathing and clothing rustle. Tactile sounds: scrape of grip, Jax's grunt hauling Roco, Roco's exhale, Rain's exhales of relief, the squeeze of her hand on his arm, Jax's tap on Roco's shoulder, three pairs of boots in staggered rhythm. Dialogue: Jax's "Roco. Hey.", Rain's "You good?" (soft, worried), Roco's "Let's move" — all with strong chamber reverb tails. No music.

PACING: six-beat structure — Roco waking (Shot 1), Jax registering with Rain visible behind him watching (Shot 2), the haul-up where Rain joins the support physically (Shot 3), Rain's worried check-in with hand on his arm (Shot 4), Roco's reassuring half-smile then decision (Shot 5), forward motion with Rain's lingering look (Shot 6). The trio is now visibly a unit of three caring for each other, not two men and an observer.

STYLE:
Style: 8K IMAX. Photorealistic, photographed on a physical motion-picture camera. No 3D render, no game engine. Genre: Modern action blockbuster. References: cinematography of Emmanuel Lubezki and Roger Deakins. No CGI-heavy feel, no game-cutscene aesthetic. Lighting: Only natural light and practicals — camera always on the shadow side of subjects, backlit contre-jour with atmospheric haze throughout. Key light comes only from the sky, windows, or on-set fixtures. Color: 60:30:10 — dominant / secondary / accent. Camera: Physical cine lens. 180° shutter motion blur. No frame-interp smoothing. Realism: Photorealistic surfaces with real-world wear, organic asymmetry, and real material behavior — skin shows pores, vellus, asymmetric moles, capillary flush with pore-shadow matching on-set light; corner vignette and edge chromatic aberration from physical lens. Gravity, inertia, and follow-through respected — mass has real weight, every object casts correct contact shadows. No render-look, no floating or duplicated props. Continuity: All characters, props, environment, and lighting stay identical across every frame and every cut. No identity drift, no appearance changes. Acting: Hollywood-grade — micro-pauses before reactions, precise eye-line, wet living eyes with practical catch-lights and micro-saccades, visible breath and chest rise, pre-speech micro-swallow, inter-beat micro-expressions. No playing to camera. Composition: Thirds + golden ratio. Every person moving from frame one, no static figures. Technical: 60fps smooth motion, 8K detail. No jitter, no identity drift. Audio: Environmental SFX only. No music, no subtitles.

STYLE:
Style: 8K IMAX. Photorealistic, photographed on a physical motion-picture camera. No 3D render, no game engine. Genre: Modern action blockbuster. References: cinematography of Emmanuel Lubezki and Roger Deakins. No CGI-heavy feel, no game-cutscene aesthetic. Lighting: Only natural light and practicals — camera always on the shadow side of subjects, backlit contre-jour with atmospheric haze throughout. Key light comes only from the sky, windows, or on-set fixtures. Color: 60:30:10 — dominant / secondary / accent. Camera: Physical cine lens. 180° shutter motion blur. No frame-interp smoothing. Realism: Photorealistic surfaces with real-world wear, organic asymmetry, and real material behavior — skin shows pores, vellus, asymmetric moles, capillary flush with pore-shadow matching on-set light; corner vignette and edge chromatic aberration from physical lens. Gravity, inertia, and follow-through respected — mass has real weight, every object casts correct contact shadows. No render-look, no floating or duplicated props. Continuity: All characters, props, environment, and lighting stay identical across every frame and every cut. No identity drift, no appearance changes. Acting: Hollywood-grade — micro-pauses before reactions, precise eye-line, wet living eyes with practical catch-lights and micro-saccades, visible breath and chest rise, pre-speech micro-swallow, inter-beat micro-expressions. No playing to camera. Composition: Thirds + golden ratio. Every person moving from frame one, no static figures. Technical: 60fps smooth motion, 8K detail. No jitter, no identity drift. Audio: Environmental SFX only. No music, no subtitles.

Setting: vast cavern-sanctum carved from natural rock, fifteen meters wide, forty meters long. Towering carved stone column-faces flank both side walls, receding into darkness. Irregular flagstone floor. Two parallel lines of small iron oil-lamps flickering warm amber along the side walls, stretching toward a vanishing point. Ceiling lost in shadow far above. At the far end on the chamber's central axis: a colossal seated stone warrior statue, bald, muscled, ancient armor carved into stone, severe carved face, hands cupped together in his lap. Cold pale daylight shaft falls from a natural rock fissure above onto the statue. On the statue's cupped hands at lap-height four meters above the floor: an elderly East Asian monk in dark maroon robes, short grey hair, seated cross-legged in meditation, motionless, eyes closed. A small candle flame beside him on the stone palm. The trio walks down the central axis of the sanctum from the entrance end toward the statue.

Shot 1 (0-2.5s): Handheld low-angle tight on three pairs of boots walking on flagstone, 50mm wider lens, shallow focus. Camera at floor level dollies backward at their walking pace. Roco's boots center, Jax's right, Rain's left — moving in measured rhythm. Each footfall deliberate. A warm oil-lamp bokeh smears in and out of the right edge of frame as they pass it. Behind their boots, the deep dark sanctum floor recedes in shallow-focus blur, oil-lamp lines stretching away on both sides. Frame breathes with subtle handheld drift. Audio: three pairs of footsteps on flagstone with deep chamber reverb in slightly staggered rhythm, soft individual oil-lamp crackle as they pass, ambient cavern drone underneath, distant water drop, their breathing settling.

Rain's eyes track to the left wall, then the right, then upward, then forward — taking it all in methodically, leader-mode reasserting itself. The interior of the sanctum recedes ahead into deep space. At the far end on the chamber's central axis: a colossal seated stone warrior statue, bald, muscled, ancient armor, severe carved face, hands cupped together in his lap. Cold pale daylight shaft falls from a natural rock fissure above onto the statue. On the statue's cupped hands four meters above the floor: an elderly East Asian monk in dark maroon robes, short grey hair, seated cross-legged in meditation, motionless, eyes closed, a small candle flame beside him on the stone palm. Roco lies face-down on the flagstones at the foot of the slab. Jax and Rain crouched close beside him.

Pupil sharp, jaw tight. Behind him in liquid blur, the sealed slab as a dark mass with dust drifting. Off-screen above, Rain's voice cracking with worry, sharp chamber reverb: "ROCO!" Behind Jax's shoulder in shallow blur, Rain leans in close, eyes locked on Roco. Jax claps Roco's shoulder firmly off-frame: "Damn, bro — that was close!" Audio: his line tail with reverb, his huffed laugh, both Jax and Rain breathing audibly fast with adrenaline, ambient drone, slab's dying reverb still in the air.

Roco grunts, pushes off the floor, comes up onto his knees, then to his feet in one continuous motion. He lands solid, balanced. The operator RISES WITH THEM, body lifting from crouch to standing, frame breathing with the rise. The slab fills the dark background. Jax and Rain hold his arms a beat longer scanning his face. Roco shrugs off both grips at once — controlled, not rough. He stands on his own. Frame agitated, alive with adrenaline. Her breath catches once, voice low and uneven, the worry plain, with chamber reverb: "You good?" Audio: her ragged breathing, the question with audible worry, long reverb tail, ambient drone.

Format: anamorphic widescreen cinema, IMAX scale, captured on physical anamorphic glass — the image reads as feature film, not video, not game cutscene, not 3D render.

Silhouettes are the primary compositional anchor of every frame — the light gives you the EDGE of the subject, not the surface.
Sky: ALWAYS A RAGING STORM — heavy black-purple cloud layer churning overhead in every shot, crimson and red-orange lightning forking continuously through it, the storm never settles, never breaks open to clear sky. Distant low-frequency thunder rolls under the soundscape.

Bodies and faces are CARVED OUT OF DARKNESS — the rim-light gives you the contour, the lightning briefly REVEALS detail then SNAPS BACK to deep shadow. Deep red horizon glow as the only sustained baseline. No fill, no bounce light. Thick atmospheric haze and drifting smoke fill every layer of the frame — the air dense with rolling smoke that catches every lightning strike and back-light, softens silhouettes, separates depth layers, never clears.

Palette 60:30:10 — dominant deep black wet stone / secondary dried-blood crimson and ember orange-red / accent electric cold blue (Soroh's glowing eyes only, the single point of cool light in the scene).

Skin catches scattered back-light realistically — sub-surface scattering on backlit ear edges, nostrils, fingertips. Character is integrated into the volumetric light, haze, and depth of the scene — same light sources, same atmosphere, same motion physics.

oranges and pinks in highlights. Saturated but cinematic.

画面中是数千上万的僵尸武士的无尽海洋, 不是数百, 是数千. 在画面前景+中景+后景都被密集填满骷髅武士——前景密集到镜头紧贴他们的面孔, 中景密集到几乎看不到他们之间的间隙, 后景延伸到雾里看不到尽头, 只看到无限的影子. 整片地面完全看不到一寸干净的雪——只有无尽的密集骷髅武士群+雾+雪. 单帧中可见500-1000人数级别, 暗示10000+人在更远处. 他们像潮水般包围Roco, 一波接一波从所有方向不停涌入. 当前面的武士被切倒, 后面立即有更多冲上来填补.

从地下出现指令: 一些不只是从远处冲来——他们也从雪地下面爬出来直接出现在Roco周围. 骷髅手臂突然从积雪中冲破出来抓住空气, 头颅顶起雪面浮出, 整个身体从雪地中爬出来站起加入冲击——僵尸从地面reanimating, 雪从他们的盔甲上落下当他们升起. 这种现象在每个镜头里至少看到5-8次.

武士的运动指令——关键(贯穿所有镜头, 包括背景): 所有+始终主动地朝Roco的方向奔跑/冲锋——前景的武士冲过来攻击, 中景的武士奔跑接近, 后景的武士也持续跑步向Roco所在位置移动. 后景的海洋始终在动态运动中——他们手持武器奔跑, 跨过被切倒的同伴, 推开前面的同伴, 渴望接近Roco投入战斗. 整个画面中所有武士的运动矢量都指向Roco——所有人在跑步/冲锋/向中心涌动. 他们用骨手伸向他+用武器对准他+嘴张大露牙齿渴望咬他+腿在快速奔跑中. 即使后景的武士很远, 他们也在快速跑步靠近——背景就像永远涌动的海洋, 没有任何武士站立不动.

后景动态指令——关键: 后景所有始终保持动态奔跑/冲锋的姿态——双腿快速移动, 手挥舞武器, 头朝向Roco, 身体向前倾斜表示在跑步. 即使是远处雾中的武士, 也是奔跑的剪影/影子, 而不是静止的站立姿态. 整个后景就是一片永远向前涌动的死亡潮水.

骑兵必须回头继续攻击指令——关键: 骑兵不能简单地骑过Roco身边消失——如果一匹骑兵冲过他没有击中, 那匹骑兵必须立即勒马转身回头, 重新对准Roco冲过来再次攻击. 骑兵们围绕Roco做有序的攻击循环——冲锋→错过/被Roco挡或闪避→勒马急转身→重新冲锋→再尝试用yari长矛突刺Roco. 他们持续地用长矛突刺尝试击中Roco, 不放弃. 这表现死灵骑兵的执着追杀.

Roco从拳头延伸出红色水晶刀刃主动parry+格挡+反击指令: 当骑兵的yari长矛刺向Roco时, Roco从拳头延伸出红色水晶刀刃主动parry/格挡/拨开长矛——剑和矛的金属性碰撞产生火花+水晶碎片+矛碎片. Roco不是被动接受攻击, 而是主动用剑撞开和反击.

Roco перекатывается под конями+一刀劈开马和骑士指令——关键: Roco的关键战术是使用沉重的战斗перекат/翻滚/低姿态滚到接近的骑兵的马的下方/侧面——然后从马的下方或侧面从拳头延伸出红色水晶刀刃做一个垂直/斜向的强力挥砍, 一刀同时切开马+骑士成两半. 切割从马的肚子向上穿过马身体+穿过骑士的身体——整个马+骑士被同时纵向劈成两半. 两半在空气中分离然后整体崩解成黑色尘雾爆发. 这是Roco对付骑兵的主要手段.

光学规则——关键: Roco左手按着的右肋骨位置(<<<1d58fa3e-7359-4376-bb67-ea43d20c8fdb>>>水晶铠甲胸甲右侧)是普通的水晶板甲表面+他的手按着——可见的水晶纹理+小裂纹+反射环境光. 整套<<<1d58fa3e-7359-4376-bb67-ea43d20c8fdb>>>铠甲表面只反射环境光, 通过折射产生深红色光斑. 从手部延伸出的红色水晶刀刃剑同样只反射环境光. 角色的颜色来自材质和折射, 来自周围光源, 来自雪暴中的散光.

VFX指令——黑色灰烬崩解(关键): 当Roco从手部延伸出的红色水晶刀刃切到任何僵尸武士时(或), 被切的部位立刻在空气中崩解成一团黑色烟雾/灰烬/烬末并飘散开. 整个被切成两半的身体变成黑色灰烬云团, 断肢变成黑色尘埃puffs飞散在雪上. 黑色灰烬粒子真实物理感+被风带走+在空中飘散+落在白雪上形成黑色斑点. 关键——僵尸的血液本质是黑色烟雾, 被切伤位置喷出黑色灰烬云团代替血.

摄影机指令——非常活跃手持剧烈摇晃反应性相机(关键):
全程是非常活跃的手持剧烈摇晃反应性相机, 像战地摄影师亲自冲入战场跟着Roco跑. 摄影机全程是有机的活的手持(operator-held)+持续的呼吸式微动+反应性振动, 持续地跳动+晃动+漂移. 当Roco做低姿势滑铲: 摄影机猛地下沉跟随他到地面, 急速横向跟拍他滑行的轨迹, 雪粉直接溅到镜头上. 当Roco挥剑: 摄影机snap跟随剑的弧形轨迹+whip pan跟着剑刃在空中划过+在挥砍顶点反应性jolt. 当敌人崩解成黑色尘雾: 摄影机微小hold然后立刻whip到下一个动作. 当Roco被打: 摄影机急剧反应性jolt模拟冲击. 持续呼吸式微动+操作员手抖. 反应快的whip pans从一个动作切到另一个动作. 摄影机自己也是战斗中的一员, 像第二个角色.
动态CU指令——关键(贯穿所有镜头): 在动作之间和动作中频繁插入动态CU特写镜头(85mm/macro CU)——每0.5-1秒插入一个超快CU(0.2-0.5秒长度)给到关键瞬间: Roco的脸/眼睛+剑刃切入敌人的瞬间+敌人脸部崩解的瞬间+水晶碎片飞过镜头+雪粉飞溅+黑色烟雾喷出+撞击瞬间+马蹄+战场细节. 这些动态CU节奏快+反应性强+在动作中给到细节冲击, 像Edgar Wright/Snyder/Tarantino式的快速插入. 动态CU之间通过snap whip pan/cut连接, 摄影机在它们之间也保持handheld dрожь.

史诗战斗指令: 战斗必须是史诗级的——大幅度英雄式动作+大量同时发生的死亡+空中飞舞的黑灰烬+雪粉飞溅+斜光戏剧性地穿透雾气. Roco是这个海洋中唯一的红色亮点——红色水晶骑士对抗黑色钢铁骨骼海洋. Kurosawa Ran最终决战+Helm's Deep+300+Northman+Battle of the Bastards的史诗混合.

沉重痛苦指令——关键(适用于Roco的每个动作):
Roco的每一个动作都是沉重的+穿透痛苦的(every Roco motion is HEAVY and pushed THROUGH PAIN). 他已经受伤(肋骨)+疲惫到极限+每次挥剑都需要全力+每次落地都让他咬牙. 没有轻盈优雅的动作——每一次挥砍是用身体的重量带着痛苦扔出去的+落地时身体一震+每次起身都缓慢沉重+每次喘气都明显. 在重击之间他用剑撑地或用一只手按肋骨获得短暂喘息. 表情(透过半透明红色水晶)持续紧绷+咬牙+痛苦但坚持. 他不是优雅的剑客, 是在地狱中挣扎的勇士——每一秒都是用意志推动的.

头盔规则——关键: Roco始终戴着<<<1d58fa3e-7359-4376-bb67-ea43d20c8fdb>>>红色水晶头盔, 头盔完整覆盖整个面部. 头盔上有许多向外伸出的红色水晶尖刺/水晶丛, 面部表面是半透明的红色水晶. 我们看到Roco的眼睛和部分眉毛是通过这条半透明红色水晶看到的<<<a8ef1f8e-1040-41a5-829a-125472cc3085>>>——眼睛在红色水晶之间清晰可见. 当镜头给到Roco的脸部CU时, 镜头紧凑特写头盔的半透明红色水晶部分, 眼睛和眉毛在水晶半透明红色水晶后面可见, 周围环绕着红色水晶尖刺和水晶纹理. 头盔受击时表面出现裂纹, 然后立即长出新水晶覆盖填补. 头盔的形态始终保持: 圆顶水晶+顶部超长尖刺+半透明红色水晶+水晶尖刺装饰.

翻滚+空翻+跳跃指令——关键(替代任何"滑铲"概念):
Roco不做滑铲——他做翻滚+空翻+跳跃(NOT slides — Roco does ROLLS / SOMERSAULTS / JUMPS instead). 包括: 战斗翻滚(combat rolls forward / sideways), 空翻(somersaults / flips, sometimes mid-fight), 跳跃(jumps over enemies or cleaving downward from height). 在每个翻滚+空翻+跳跃的动作中他同时挥砍剑——剑刃在空翻轨迹中划过敌人. 这些动作沉重而不是轻盈——尽管是acrobatic, 但他做的时候明显沉重+穿透痛苦+落地有重量感.

剑的光学规则——关键: 从手部延伸出的红色水晶刀刃是被动光学水晶, 表面只反射环境光——像真实的玻璃/水晶, 通过折射环境光产生深红色/猩红的光斑. 在浓雾和雪暴中剑的颜色是深红色到暗红色, 反射光时有亮点. 剑的颜色来自材质本身和折射, 不来自内部发光.

整片战场被巨大的雪暴和极其浓厚的冷蓝灰色雾完全覆盖. 每一帧画面都必须有: 大量白色雪花密集穿过画面前景和后景飘落+雪粉被强风刮起+浓厚的冷蓝灰色雾在中景和后景层叠堆积+能见度只有30-50米+地平线完全消失在白雾里+雾在角色周围漂动+斜光从雾中透入. 雪暴是blizzard级别——非常密的雪+大风+冰晶在空中. 雾几乎是固体般的厚——后景看不清, 远处的武士群在雾中模糊但仍密集.

海量规模指令——大幅增加(关键):
画面中是数千上万的僵尸武士的无尽海洋, 不是数百, 是数千. 在画面前景+中景+后景都被密集填满骷髅武士——前景密集到镜头紧贴他们的面孔, 中景密集到几乎看不到他们之间的间隙, 后景延伸到雾里看不到尽头, 只看到无限的影子. 整片地面完全看不到一寸干净的雪——只有无尽的密集骷髅武士群+雾+雪. 单帧中可见500-1000人数级别, 暗示10000+人在更远处. 他们像潮水般包围Roco, 一波接一波从所有方向不停涌入. 当前面的武士被切倒, 后面立即有更多冲上来填补.

从地下出现指令: 一些不只是从远处冲来——他们也从雪地下面爬出来直接出现在Roco周围. 骷髅手臂突然从积雪中冲破出来抓住空气, 头颅顶起雪面浮出, 整个身体从雪地中爬出来站起加入冲击——僵尸从地面reanimating, 雪从他们的盔甲上落下当他们升起. 这种现象在每个镜头里至少看到5-8次.

武士的运动指令——关键(贯穿所有镜头, 包括背景): 所有+始终主动地朝Roco的方向奔跑/冲锋——前景的武士冲过来攻击, 中景的武士奔跑接近, 后景的武士也持续跑步向Roco所在位置移动. 后景的海洋始终在动态运动中——他们手持武器奔跑, 跨过被切倒的同伴, 推开前面的同伴, 渴望接近Roco投入战斗. 整个画面中所有武士的运动矢量都指向Roco——所有人在跑步/冲锋/向中心涌动. 他们用骨手伸向他+用武器对准他+嘴张大露牙齿渴望咬他+腿在快速奔跑中. 即使后景的武士很远, 他们也在快速跑步靠近——背景就像永远涌动的海洋, 没有任何武士站立不动.

后景动态指令——关键: 后景所有始终保持动态奔跑/冲锋的姿态——双腿快速移动, 手挥舞武器, 头朝向Roco, 身体向前倾斜表示在跑步. 即使是远处雾中的武士, 也是奔跑的剪影/影子, 而不是静止的站立姿态. 整个后景就是一片永远向前涌动的死亡潮水.

骑兵必须回头继续攻击指令——关键: 骑兵不能简单地骑过Roco身边消失——如果一匹骑兵冲过他没有击中, 那匹骑兵必须立即勒马转身回头, 重新对准Roco冲过来再次攻击. 骑兵们围绕Roco做有序的攻击循环——冲锋→错过/被Roco挡或闪避→勒马急转身→重新冲锋→再尝试用yari长矛突刺Roco. 他们持续地用长矛突刺尝试击中Roco, 不放弃. 这表现死灵骑兵的执着追杀.

Roco从拳头延伸出红色水晶刀刃主动parry+格挡+反击指令: 当骑兵的yari长矛刺向Roco时, Roco从拳头延伸出红色水晶刀刃主动parry/格挡/拨开长矛——剑和矛的金属性碰撞产生火花+水晶碎片+矛碎片. Roco不是被动接受攻击, 而是主动用剑撞开和反击.

Roco перекатывается под конями+一刀劈开马和骑士指令——关键: Roco的关键战术是使用沉重的战斗перекат/翻滚/低姿态滚到接近的骑兵的马的下方/侧面——然后从马的下方或侧面从拳头延伸出红色水晶刀刃做一个垂直/斜向的强力挥砍, 一刀同时切开马+骑士成两半. 切割从马的肚子向上穿过马身体+穿过骑士的身体——整个马+骑士被同时纵向劈成两半. 两半在空气中分离然后整体崩解成黑色尘雾爆发. 这是Roco对付骑兵的主要手段.

光学规则——关键: Roco左手按着的右肋骨位置(<<<1d58fa3e-7359-4376-bb67-ea43d20c8fdb>>>水晶铠甲胸甲右侧)是普通的水晶板甲表面+他的手按着——可见的水晶纹理+小裂纹+反射环境光. 整套<<<1d58fa3e-7359-4376-bb67-ea43d20c8fdb>>>铠甲表面只反射环境光, 通过折射产生深红色光斑. 从手部延伸出的红色水晶刀刃剑同样只反射环境光. 角色的颜色来自材质和折射, 来自周围光源, 来自雪暴中的散光.

VFX指令——黑色灰烬崩解(关键): 当Roco从手部延伸出的红色水晶刀刃切到任何僵尸武士时(或), 被切的部位立刻在空气中崩解成一团黑色烟雾/灰烬/烬末并飘散开. 整个被切成两半的身体变成黑色灰烬云团, 断肢变成黑色尘埃puffs飞散在雪上. 黑色灰烬粒子真实物理感+被风带走+在空中飘散+落在白雪上形成黑色斑点. 关键——僵尸的血液本质是黑色烟雾, 被切伤位置喷出黑色灰烬云团代替血.

摄影机指令——非常活跃手持剧烈摇晃反应性相机(关键):
全程是非常活跃的手持剧烈摇晃反应性相机, 像战地摄影师亲自冲入战场跟着Roco跑. 摄影机全程是有机的活的手持(operator-held)+持续的呼吸式微动+反应性振动, 持续地跳动+晃动+漂移. 当Roco做低姿势滑铲: 摄影机猛地下沉跟随他到地面, 急速横向跟拍他滑行的轨迹, 雪粉直接溅到镜头上. 当Roco挥剑: 摄影机snap跟随剑的弧形轨迹+whip pan跟着剑刃在空中划过+在挥砍顶点反应性jolt. 当敌人崩解成黑色尘雾: 摄影机微小hold然后立刻whip到下一个动作. 当Roco被打: 摄影机急剧反应性jolt模拟冲击. 持续呼吸式微动+操作员手抖. 反应快的whip pans从一个动作切到另一个动作. 摄影机自己也是战斗中的一员, 像第二个角色.
动态 CU指令——关键(贯穿所有镜头): 在动作之间和动作中频繁插入动态 CU特写镜头(85mm/macro CU)——每0.5-1秒插入一个超快 CU(0.2-0.5秒长度)给到关键瞬间: Roco的脸/眼睛+剑刃切入敌人的瞬间+敌人脸部崩解的瞬间+水晶碎片飞过镜头+雪粉飞溅+黑色烟雾喷出+撞击瞬间+马蹄+战场细节. 这些动态 CU节奏快+反应性强+在动作中给到细节冲击, 像Edgar Wright/Snyder/Tarantino式的快速插入. 动态 CU之间通过snap whip pan/cut连接, 摄影机在它们之间也保持handheld dрожь.

史诗战斗指令: 战斗必须是史诗级的——大幅度英雄式动作+大量同时发生的死亡+空中飞舞的黑灰烬+雪粉飞溅+斜光戏剧性地穿透雾气. Roco是这个海洋中唯一的红色亮点——红色水晶骑士对抗黑色钢铁骨骼海洋. Kurosawa Ran最终决战+Helm's Deep+300+Northman+Battle of the Bastards的史诗混合.

沉重痛苦指令——关键(适用于Roco的每个动作):
Roco的每一个动作都是沉重的+穿透痛苦的(every Roco motion is HEAVY and pushed THROUGH PAIN). 他已经受伤(肋骨)+疲惫到极限+每次挥剑都需要全力+每次落地都让他咬牙. 没有轻盈优雅的动作——每一次挥砍是用身体的重量带着痛苦扔出去的+落地时身体一震+每次起身都缓慢沉重+每次喘气都明显. 在重击之间他用剑撑地或用一只手按肋骨获得短暂喘息. 表情(透过半透明红色水晶)持续紧绷+咬牙+痛苦但坚持. 他不是优雅的剑客, 是在地狱中挣扎的勇士——每一秒都是用意志推动的.

头盔规则——关键: Roco始终戴着<<<1d58fa3e-7359-4376-bb67-ea43d20c8fdb>>>红色水晶头盔, 头盔完整覆盖整个面部. 头盔上有许多向外伸出的红色水晶尖刺/水晶丛, 面部表面是半透明的红色水晶. Roco的眼睛和部分眉毛是通过这层半透明红色水晶可见——眼睛在红色水晶之间清晰可见. 当镜头给到Roco的脸部 CU时, 镜头紧凑特写头盔的半透明红色水晶部分, 眼睛和眉毛在半透明红色水晶后面可见, 周围环绕着红色水晶尖刺和水晶纹理. 头盔受击时表面出现裂纹, 然后立即长出新水晶覆盖填补. 头盔的形态始终保持: 圆顶水晶+顶部超长尖刺+半透明红色水晶+水晶尖刺装饰.

翻滚+空翻+跳跃指令——关键(替代任何"滑铲"概念):
Roco不做滑铲——他做翻滚+空翻+跳跃(NOT slides — Roco does ROLLS / SOMERSAULTS / JUMPS instead). 包括: 战斗翻滚(combat rolls forward / sideways), 空翻(somersaults / flips, sometimes mid-fight), 跳跃(jumps over enemies or cleaving downward from height). 在每个翻滚+空翻+跳跃的动作中他同时挥砍剑——剑刃在空翻轨迹中划过敌人. 这些动作沉重而不是轻盈——尽管是acrobatic, 但他做的时候明显沉重+穿透痛苦+落地有重量感.

剑的光学规则——关键: 从手部延伸出的红色水晶刀刃是被动光学水晶, 表面只反射环境光——像真实的玻璃/水晶, 通过折射环境光产生深红色/猩红的光斑. 在浓雾和雪暴中剑的颜色是深红色到暗红色, 反射光时有亮点. 剑的颜色来自材质本身和折射, 不来自内部发光.

镜头: 24-35mm广角用于战斗WS+MS, 50mm用于近距离MS, 85mm用于Roco脸部 CU, 14mm广角用于骑兵冲锋+海洋全景.

Roco是混乱中央的一个红色风暴, 砍杀身边任何接近的目标——不区分对象+所有靠近他的都被切. 当骑兵接近时, Roco有时会做一个低姿态翻滚到马的下方+从下方向上挥砍切开马+骑士成两半(一击同时切开马身+骑兵). 他像被困在中央的怒火, 砍杀一切靠近的目标.

Roco<<<7775a76e-1932-4d82-bc5b-efd21834b2c4>>>锋利水晶手臂主动parry+格挡+反击指令: 当骑兵的yari长矛刺向Roco时, Roco<<<7775a76e-1932-4d82-bc5b-efd21834b2c4>>>锋利水晶手臂主动parry/格挡/拨开长矛——<<<7775a76e-1932-4d82-bc5b-efd21834b2c4>>>锋利水晶手臂和铁矛的碰撞产生+水晶碎片+矛碎片. Roco不是被动接受攻击, 而是主动用<<<7775a76e-1932-4d82-bc5b-efd21834b2c4>>>锋利水晶手臂撞开和反击.

摄影机指令——非常活跃手持剧烈摇晃反应性相机(关键):
全程是非常活跃的手持剧烈摇晃反应性相机, 像战地摄影师亲自冲入战场跟着Roco跑. 摄影机全程是有机的活的手持(operator-held)+持续的呼吸式微动+反应性振动, 持续地跳动+晃动+漂移. 当Roco做低姿势滑铲: 摄影机猛地下沉跟随他到地面, 急速横向跟拍他滑行的轨迹, 雪粉直接溅到镜头上. 当Roco挥动<<<7775a76e-1932-4d82-bc5b-efd21834b2c4>>>锋利水晶手臂: 摄影机snap跟随<<<7775a76e-1932-4d82-bc5b-efd21834b2c4>>>锋利水晶手臂的弧形轨迹+whip pan跟着<<<7775a76e-1932-4d82-bc5b-efd21834b2c4>>>锋利水晶手臂在空中划过+在挥砍顶点反应性jolt. 当敌人崩解成黑色尘雾: 摄影机微小hold然后立刻whip到下一个动作. 当Roco被打: 摄影机急剧反应性jolt模拟冲击. 持续呼吸式微动+操作员手抖. 反应快的whip pans从一个动作切到另一个动作. 摄影机自己也是战斗中的一员, 像第二个角色.

Roco的每一个动作都是缓慢沉重+全力推进的(every Roco motion is HEAVY and pushed THROUGH PAIN). 他疲惫到极限+每次挥动<<<7775a76e-1932-4d82-bc5b-efd21834b2c4>>>锋利水晶手臂都需要全力+每次落地都让他身体绷紧. 没有轻盈优雅的动作——每一次挥砍是用身体的重量带着沉重扔出去的+落地时身体一震+每次起身都缓慢沉重+每次胸部水晶起伏都明显. 表情(透过完全不透明的红色水晶)持续紧绷+身体绷紧但坚持. 他不是优雅的战士, 是在地狱中挣扎的勇士——每一秒都是用意志推动的. 他可以双臂战斗——挥动整条右臂<<<7775a76e-1932-4d82-bc5b-efd21834b2c4>>>锋利水晶手臂砍杀+左臂可以辅助抓握/突击/格挡或者偶尔武器化加入双武器攻击.

头盔规则——关键: Roco始终戴着<<<1d58fa3e-7359-4376-bb67-ea43d20c8fdb>>>红色水晶头盔, 头盔完整覆盖整个头部. 头盔上有许多向外伸出的红色水晶尖刺/水晶丛, 头盔表面是密集的完全不透明的红色水晶尖刺集群+水晶纹理. 当镜头给到头盔CU时, 镜头紧凑特写头盔的完全不透明的红色水晶+周围环绕着红色水晶尖刺和水晶纹理+表面反射环境光. 头盔受击时表面出现裂纹, 然后立即长出新水晶覆盖填补. 头盔的形态始终保持: 圆顶水晶+顶部超长尖刺+完全不透明的红色水晶+水晶尖刺装饰.
